# Minny Apparel

> Minny Apparel (MinnyApparel Inc.) is an apparel startup from Minneapolis, Minnesota, started at the University of Minnesota. It makes Minny, a patent-pending purse that unfolds into a down-and-feather puffer jacket in under 30 seconds and folds back into a purse.

- Official website: https://minnyapparel.com/
- Company name: Minny Apparel. Product name: Minny.
- Product: convertible purse-to-puffer jacket for nights out in cold weather, so there is no coat to check or carry.
- Status: available for pre-order from the first production run. Ships within the United States.
- Contact: contact@minnyapparel.com

## Pages

- [Home and product](https://minnyapparel.com/): what Minny is, how it transforms, FAQ, pre-order
